title: Peak Workload Distribution
scenario: Find the peak hour of bug reporting for each team and identify if it aligns with their highest MTTR.
tableSchema: developers (dev_id INT, team_id INT), bugs (bug_id INT, reporter_id INT, created_at TIMESTAMP)
correctQuery: SELECT team_id, report_hour FROM (SELECT team_id, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) as report_hour, COUNT(*), RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk FROM developers d JOIN bugs b ON d.dev_id = b.reporter_id GROUP BY team_id, report_hour) t WHERE rnk = 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE developers (dev_id INT, team_id INT); CREATE TABLE bugs (bug_id INT, reporter_id INT, created_at TIMESTAMP);
